name: research
description: Find information and verify it before trusting it — search the live web with Exa, answer only from citable official sources or refuse (cite-or-refuse), and rule every factual claim in a document VALID / INVALID / INCONCLUSIVE with sources (fact-check-document). Supply an Exa API key to enable web search.

EXA_API_KEY.title: Exa API Key
EXA_API_KEY.description: API key for Exa web search (https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys), sent as the x-api-key header to the hosted MCP at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp. Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo; maintainer copy is SOPS-encrypted in secrets/exa.sops.json.
